D"],"published-print":{"date-parts":[[2022,10,15]]},"abstract":"<jats:p>We show that if a massive body is put in a quantum superposition of spatially separated states, the mere presence of a black hole in the vicinity of the body will eventually destroy the coherence of the superposition. This occurs because, in effect, the gravitational field of the body radiates soft gravitons into the black hole, allowing the black hole to acquire \u201cwhich path\u201d information about the superposition. A similar effect occurs for quantum superpositions of electrically charged bodies. We provide estimates of the decoherence time for such quantum superpositions. We believe that the fact that a black hole will eventually decohere any quantum superposition may be of fundamental significance for our understanding of the nature of black holes in a quantum theory of gravity.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1142\/s0218271822410036","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2022,5,24]],"date-time":"2022-05-24T06:39:28Z","timestamp":1653374368000},"source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":57,"title":["Black holes decohere quantum superpositions"],"prefix":"10.1142","volume":"31","author":[{"given":"Daine L.","family":"Danielson","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"Enrico Fermi Institute and Department of Physics, The University of Chicago, Chicago, Illinois 60637, USA"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Gautam","family":"Satishchandran","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Enrico Fermi Institute and Department of Physics, The University of Chicago, Chicago, Illinois 60637, USA"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Robert M.","family":"Wald","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Enrico Fermi Institute and Department of Physics, The University of Chicago, Chicago, Illinois 60637, USA"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"219","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2022,7,18]]},"reference":[{"key":"S0218271822410036BIB001","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","DOI":"10.1088\/1361-6633\/aa778e"},{"key":"S0218271822410036BIB002","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","DOI":"10.1088\/1361-6633\/aa77cc"},{"key":"S0218271822410036BIB003","doi-asserted-by":"crossref","first-page":"086001","DOI":"10.1103\/PhysRevD.105.086001","volume":"105","author":"Danielson D.
